text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a 30-minute walk each day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep — most adults need seven to eight hours a night. Don't forget your mental health, too. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. Small daily habits can lead to a healthier, happier life.
